svg.title: Study-specific experimental framework
svg.desc: Current-input baselines and optional temporal-history increments define separate component configurations. W denotes positive-class weight two in PTHW. Models fit Train labels independently by dataset. PaySim uses raw, clipped and Platt scores, with earlier-Validation calibration and later-Validation cost-minimising threshold selection under a 3 percent alert cap. Full-Test-score AP is separate from decision-based evaluation. PaySim also has separate exact-3-percent component contrasts; IEEE-CIS and BankSim use a primary 3 percent exact top-k budget on completed Test windows. Test labels are used only for metrics, never review selection. History construction excludes fraud labels and current groups. All icons and matrices are schematic.
